problem: Several later immutable manifests/receipts created by this worker contain manually supplied local created_at/observed_at labels between 06:02 and 06:52 +07:00, which are ahead of the actual local clock. The repository commit timestamps themselves are correct and preserve the real ordering.
scope: Assistant-authored timestamp labels only; source bytes, Drive modified times, Git blob hashes, findings, oracle results and commit ancestry are unchanged.
correction_rule: For chronological ordering of these artifacts, use Git commit created_at/commit ancestry as authoritative. Treat their manually embedded future local created_at labels as invalid metadata. Future aggregators must not infer source chronology or SLA timing from those invalid labels.
why_not_rewrite_all: The manifests are immutable evidence receipts referenced by concurrent workers. Rewriting many already-crossread files would create more merge risk than an explicit correction edge. This correction receipt supersedes only the affected timestamp fields, not content.
